_why: Phase-7 precondition gates added after doc-block-exec closed (#155 match-rate spelling, #142 parked mutation specs). Each row reverts one guard to the shape that produced a false blocker or a silent pass, and names the test that must bite.

mutations.name: match-rate-regex-narrows-back-to-whitespace-only
mutations._mechanism: #155 exactly. `_` is not `\s`, so the awk template's own `match_rate=100.00%` reads as no rate stated and the gate raises `match_rate_unreadable` on a correct analysis.

mutations.name: a-parked-spec-with-no-live-twin-reads-as-provenance
mutations._mechanism: #142 exactly: the name-match check goes dark, every parked spec is 'restored', and a spec never moved back closes the feature with its guards unmeasured.
mutations.find: target = restored if any((Path(d) / live_name).is_file() for d in spec_dirs) else unrestored

mutations.name: no-specs-dir-becomes-a-blocker-instead-of-a-warning
mutations._mechanism: 'I could not check' scored as 'never moved back': a project without a mutation-specs directory can never close a feature that parked anything.
